environment.description: Deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) running as root. The application directory /var/app/data contains user-uploaded files. The filesystem has no restrictions on symlink creation - users can upload tar archives that are extracted preserving symlinks. No reverse proxy in front of the service. The container/host has /etc/shadow, /proc/self/environ, and AWS instance metadata credentials accessible at standard paths. WebSocket connections are direct to the Go process on port 8080.

config.runtime: bare EC2, Amazon Linux 2, no containerization
config.filesystem: ext4, no mount restrictions, symlinks permitted in /var/app/data
config.network: direct exposure on port 8080, no reverse proxy
config.upload_handling: tar extraction preserves symlinks via tar -xf without --no-same-owner
